# Docs Templates

Use the files in this folder as copy/paste snippets when writing new topics. Each template is intentionally short so you can adapt the wording while keeping the same structure.

## How to Use

- Copy the fenced block you need into your page and adjust the bolded labels.
- Keep templates in ASCII unless a consumer page already uses localized text.
- When you introduce a new callout that multiple pages will need, add it here and reference it from your PR description so reviewers can confirm reuse.
